primary_estimand: Effect of a single bout of postprandial aerobic treadmill exercise (14 m/min, 3 h, started 3 h after refeeding) on the hepatic transcriptome of wild-type male C57BL/6J mice, versus sedentary littermates sampled at the same time.
sample_inclusion: 12 liver samples, 6 Sedentary + 6 Exercise (GEO); paper's postprandial liver experiments use n = 6 males/group, 8-10 weeks (FIG3, FIG4).
planned_contrasts: Exercise vs Sedentary, liver, postprandial (S2.3.p1, Supplemental Figure 3A; paper reports only KEGG pathways, no DEG count)
repeated_measure_unit: none; independent animals per arm (S4.3.p2: half exercised, half sedentary)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.13.p1 (RNA-seq 'as described previously (27)'; KEGG via BGI Dr.Tom); S4.14.p1 (P < 0.05 t test applies to bench assays, not to the transcriptome)

paper_method: not stated: RNA-seq 'performed as described previously (27)', KEGG enrichment with BGI Dr.Tom online tool (S4.13.p1); GEO data_processing: HISAT2/Bowtie2/RSEM
paper_results: Hepatic insulin signaling pathway most dramatically regulated by exercise (S2.3.p1, Supp Fig 3A); exercise suppresses hepatic Angptl8 transcription (FIG3, S2.3.p1); Cebpa regulated by fasting and by exercise (S2.3.p2, Supp Fig 3D); exercise increases liver Angptl4 transcription (S2.4.p2, Supp Fig 4C).
